regulatory_frameworks.notes: Release 0.4.0a1 preserves the 0.3.0 PCG/FEC cross-lot qualification unchanged and adds generic subledger foundations with explicit version-aware control-account resolution. LOT-18 does not broaden PCG statutory-template, legal-filing, DGFiP-filing or authority-submission claims; settlement, allocation, matching, aging and subledger reconciliation remain outside this alpha milestone.

SYSCOHADA remains qualified through LOT-17 deterministic XOF golden and replay scenarios. Release 0.4.0a1 adds generic subledger foundations without changing the existing SYSCOHADA regulatory qualification boundary and without claiming an equivalent FEC ingestion path or statutory filing certification.
